verdict.rationale: An on-device inference SDK/CLI could plausibly advertise cold-start time or a lightweight runtime, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence on startup latency, model-load time or binary size. The closest items are 'one C++ core, six thin bindings', which is about cross-platform architecture, and tok/s throughput benchmarks, which measure generation speed; neither says anything about how fast inference begins from cold.
